messages:
alex: Morning — can we lock in a regular oncall handoff + triage slot? I'm thinking daily 10:00am PT, 15m quick sync, and a weekly 30m deep triage for open incidents. Who needs to be on escalation by default?

maria: Daily 10 is ok for most days but conflicts with a weekly product sync for me. Could we do 9:45 instead? 15m keeps it fast. :clock9:45:

devon: 9:45 works. Also +1 to short daily = async first, then live if there are >1 Sev2/1 active. We can gate live triage with a quick incident count check.

sre-bot: Automated update: currently 2 open incidents (INC-472, INC-479). No active P1.

jamie: Proposal: keep daily short handoff + triage at 9:45 PT, 15m, rotate chair each day. Weekly deep triage Fridays 30m (agenda below). Who volunteers to be rotation owner?

alex: I'll take next week as chair. For escalation attendees: oncall eng, oncall SRE, eng lead (if tagged), and product PM if customer-facing. If P1, trigger exec-notify too.

karen: Quick ask — can we add a shared calendar event with 9:45 recurring and a link to the incident board? I'll set it once we agree on the time.

jamie: Agenda template (copy into event description):
```
Daily 15m handoff/triage — 9:45 PT
- Quick state (oncall -> next oncall): recent handover notes
- Incident count & severities (sre-bot summary)
- Active actions / blockers (2 min each)
- Decide if escalation/live triage needed (>1 Sev2 or any Sev1)
- Assign owners + followups
Weekly 30m deep triage — Friday
- Review open incidents >48h
- Postmortem status + blocking items
- Roadmap/ops changes to reduce recurrence
- Action owner + ETA
```

maria: Love the template. For rotations: propose 2-week chairs so engineers can deep-dive without constant switching.

devon: +1 for 2-week rotation. Also suggest a small on-call checklist pinned in the event: (pager runbook, recent deploys, known outages).

alex: Sounds good. Action items:
- karen: create recurring calendar at 9:45 PT + attach agenda (karen)
- jamie: add rotation schedule to the oncall doc and start 2-week cadence (jamie)
- devon: add checklist to event description (devon)
- alex: I'll post an initial rotation sign-up for the next 8 weeks.

sre-bot: Reminder: add `#incidents` board link: https://redwood.example/incidents 

maria: If anyone can't attend a day, please post an async handoff note in the thread and ping the rotation owner. :thumbsup:

devon: I'll take week after alex. Thanks — agree on 9:45 and 2-week chairs.

alex: Great — thanks all. I'll wait for the calendar + doc updates, then we'll consider this confirmed. :white_check_mark:
